newsitem.title: UK: Pilkington dips as Goldman trims forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Pilkington dips as Goldman trims forecasts.

text.p: Shares in glassmaker Pilkington Plc edged lower on Friday as analysts at Goldman Sachs lowered profit estimates for the company but repeated a "market outperformer" rating, market sources said.
The stock was down 1p at 185-1/2 by 1157 GMT.

Sources said Goldman analysts trimmed 20 million stg off their estimates for pre-tax profit in the current and next year, with float glass prices in Europe expected to be 10 percent lower in the second half of this year than last.

Goldman however said it continued to favour the stock, which has underperformed the rest of the UK market in recent months and which is trading at a discount of some 14 percent to Goldman's 250p estimate of its longer-term value.

Other brokerages including Merrill Lynch and SG Strauss Turnbull have lowered profit estimates for Pilkington in recent weeks. In July the company warned that difficult trading conditions in Europe would hit first-half results.
